pages.title: Guidance of the Falling Star
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplies to: §r Mace$(br2)§lEffect: §r While holding a mace and falling from a height, your descent slows and your entity interaction range extends, giving you more time to aim and land a hit mid-air.$(br2)Gravity modifier: -0.03 / -0.04 / -0.05$(br)Interaction range: +0.5 / +1.0 / +1.5 blocks$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Enchanting Table, loot chests, villager trades.$(br)Requires at least 2 blocks of accumulated fall distance; does not work while elytra gliding, in water, in lava, or while riding.
